name: This Is Fine
subject: a cartoon dog in a hat
origin: Two panels of 'On Fire', KC Green's 2013 Gunshow webcomic; the panels went viral after being posted to Reddit in 2014.

sources.label: NPR — a decade of 'This is fine'
Know Your Meme — This Is Fine

cultural_meaning: Calm denial in the middle of a disaster: sitting at a table with a coffee mug, smiling, while the room burns.

reflection.en: Everything around him is burning, and he keeps his cup. I would like to learn that kind of calm.
reflection.ru: Вокруг него всё горит, а он держит свою чашку. Я бы хотел научиться такому спокойствию.
reflection.de: Um ihn herum brennt alles, und er hält seine Tasse. Diese Ruhe würde ich gern lernen.
